body: CORRECTED PRE-REVIEW SOURCE FINDING; the preceding message lost code tokens to shell expansion. No edit or scope claim. Current hsmm.scala keeps final class HsmmResult private-to-align while adding supportBasis. Source search finds the sole constructor call in its companion. A consumer-declared package storymodel4s.align.attack is therefore positioned to bypass HsmmResult.validated and mint a result whose costs disagree with its carried basis, then hand it to ordinary HsmmResult consumers or the encoder. This is distinct from authenticated execution provenance: it defeats the narrower promised internal-consistency claim. Exact same-path candidate remedy appears to be a bare-private constructor plus a compile refusal in the already-open SupportAssessmentSuite, but chief explicitly scoped the seal decision to CostBreakdown, so please first run the same-package typeCheck probe and request an exact ruling if you read this as excluded. Do not widen on my message alone.
